stills.prompt: Medium close-up at chest height in the dim stone workshop of @engine. A Ghanaian man in his mid-sixties with deep brown skin, close-cropped grey hair and a full, neatly kept short grey beard, bright alert eyes, upright and strong, charcoal work shirt with sleeves rolled to the elbow under a worn dark leather apron. He holds an unfinished raw grey cast-iron flywheel casting at chest height in both hands: five straight spokes from a round hub, open gaps between them, rough sand-cast surface. Behind him at left, the original engine from @engine, brass cylinder and black iron five-spoke flywheel. His face in the upper third, turned three-quarters toward the engine, calm focus, the start of a smile. Real skin texture with visible pores, natural beard detail. One cool bone-white (#F5F2EB) light from high left, near-black background. Photorealistic, natural film grain. One person only, no lettering.
